text:
jordan: Heads-up — we need to coordinate a base-image rebuild window for swarm nodes. Planning to cutover next Tue 01:00 UTC. Need short checklist: RBAC changes, KMS signer swap, and audit log hook update. Any blockers?

liam: Are we rolling keystore rotation too? last time the keystore role change caused failed pulls.

sophia: yes, we'll rotate the keystore. Proposal: swap signer keys on canary cluster first, enable audit hook forwarding to sec-log endpoint, then roll.

alex: pinging @sec-bot for audit pipeline retention limits. Need to ensure logs keep 90 days for compliance.

sec-bot: Audit retention for container-audit is 30 days by default. To request 90 days open ticket 'INFRA-RETENTION-90' — automated reply: https://redwood.atlassian/INFRA-RETENTION-90

jordan: Ok I'll open the ticket. Also, RBAC: we need to reduce image-push perms for CI runners during cutover. Can we do a temporary role 'ci-builder-cutover' with no push?

liam: yep. I can create role with push=false and read-only for registry. Will add a TTL of 6 hours.

sophia: Quick vuln triage note: Image scanner flagged libc CVE in one layer of base image. We should hot-fix the package before rebuild. @alex can you confirm if staged patch is ready?

alex: patch is built and smoke-tested in staging. No regressions. I'll add it into the bake pipeline and publish a new tag.

jordan: workflow I'll do: 1) create ci-builder-cutover role (liam) 2) swap keystore signer on canary (sophia/alex) 3) enable audit hook to sec-log (sec-bot) 4) run vulnerability scan 5) promote to canary pool 6) full fleet. Any objections?

liam: timeline OK. Minor ask: add a rollback plan for keystore signer — in case operator fails, we need to revert to old signer (steps in ops-runbook).

sophia: added rollback snippet to the runbook: `gcloud kms keys versions create --restore=old-version` (pseudo). Also will run quick smoke test: `docker run --rm base:staged /bin/true`.

alex: publishing new baked image tag now: base:2026-03-31-patch1

jordan: Opening ticket INFRA-RETENTION-90 and a cutover checklist here: https://redwood.kb/cutovers/swarm-base-rebuild. Scheduling the window for Tue 01:00 UTC. I'll post final runbook tomorrow.

liam: I'll provision the ci-builder-cutover role at 00:45 UTC and remove at 07:00 UTC.

sec-bot: Reminder: when you flip signer, run `cosign verify --key $OLD_PUB`, and capture attestations to S3 for forensics.

sophia: noted. Also let's add an alert in monitoring: 'image-pull-failure-rate > 0.5%' to auto-pause rollout.

alex: done — added alert in prod-alerts with severity P2.

jordan: Thanks team. I'll DM any exec-level heads-up. If nothing pops up, we'll proceed. :thumbsup:

deploy-bot: Scheduled canary bake job id=cj-889 for Tue 01:10 UTC — will notify #eng-runtime on start.
